The '''Model 00 heating system''' was a type of [[Heating system/Legends|heating system]] produced by the [[Min-Dal Company]] and available as an [[Armor/Legends|armor]] enhancement. Using insulation and heating elements the Model 00 allowed its wearer to survive in temperatures far below what were normally tolerable. The system sold for 1000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Model 00 heating system was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2013]]. The same information was also included in the [[Star Wars: Age of Rebellion Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Age of Rebellion'' Core Rulebook]] released the [[2014|following year]] by Fantasy Flight Games.
